title: Amelia | Geometric stripe shirt in bold colour blocking
bodyHtml:
This shirt turns every outing into a style statement without apology. The vertical stripes in orange, violet and blue create a dynamic geometric rhythm that's instantly eye-catching and packed with personality. The relaxed, loose fit gives you complete freedom of movement—the kind of comfort that comes from a piece genuinely designed to be worn and loved. Throw it on for a day out with the girls, a summer catch-up, or whenever you want to express your creative side effortlessly.

Why you'll love it

  • Vertical geometric stripes in orange, violet and blue deliver an unmistakable visual impact that feels contemporary and bold
  • Striking colour-block design that's rare to find—this exact palette and sharp geometric cut stand out from the everyday
  • Loose, relaxed fit that skims your frame without clinging, giving you all-day comfort and complete freedom to move
  • Lightweight and breathable, staying fresh and comfortable even on the warmest days
  • Genuinely easy to style—pair with white trousers, black shorts, or jeans for a look that's audacious yet perfectly balanced
  • Works everywhere: casual catch-ups, weekend brunches, creative outings, summer drinks—never forgettable, never boring
  • Hard to find this particular combination of colour and cut; it's the kind of piece that makes you feel like you've discovered something special
